-> ASSESS -> REVIEW -> REVISE
-> FIXUP -> REASSESS_CHECK/SAVE
/ASSESS/REVIEW/RESTORE/REVISE/FIXUP

-> SPLIT_PIPELINE_START
-> SPLIT_ASSESS/REVIEW/REVISE/FIXUP
/SAVE/REASSESS/RE_REVIEW/RESTORE
-> SPLIT_CORRECTION_CHECK
-> BATCH_DONE -> ERROR_COLLECT
-> REPORT -> DONE
